<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Telephone Card|id=A0122}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
In this lesson Liliana and JP tell us all about phone cards, in particular how to buy one in Lojban—and why you should. The keyword is: '''tarjeta de teléfono''' – phone card. 
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0005|A0005: Take a picture]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0023|A0023: Going to the market]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0056|A0056: What time is the train?]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿Me da una tarjeta de teléfono?'''
| Will you give me a phone card?
| '''¿Para llamadas nacionales o internacionales?'''
| For domestic or international calls?
| '''Internacionales.'''
| International calls.
| '''Diez euros.'''
| Ten euros.
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thank you.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¿Me da una tarjeta de teléfono?'''
| Will you give me a phone card?
| '''¿Para llamadas nacionales o internacionales?'''
| For domestic or international calls?
| '''Internacionales.'''
| International calls.
| '''Diez euros.'''
| Ten euros.
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thank you.
}}</includeonly>

Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Will you give me a phone card?
| '''¿Me da una tarjeta de teléfono?'''
| For domestic or international calls?
| '''¿Para llamadas nacionales o internacionales?'''
| International calls.
| '''Internacionales.'''
| Ten euros.
| '''Diez euros.'''
| Thank you.
| '''Gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Will you give me a card?
| '''¿Me da una tarjeta?'''
| A card?
| '''¿Una tarjeta?
| For international calls.
| '''Para llamadas internacionales.'''
| A telephone card?
| '''¿Una tarjeta de teléfono?'''
| Yes ({{=}} '''sí''')! Will you give me a telephone card?
| '''¡Sí! ¿Me da una tarjeta de teléfono?
| For international calls?
| '''¿Para llamadas internacionales?'''
| Yes, for international calls.
| '''Sí, para llamadas internacionales.'''
| Ten euros.
| '''Diez euros.'''
| Thank you.
| '''Gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Will you give me a card?
| '''¿Me da una tarjeta?'''
| A card?
| '''¿Una tarjeta?
| For international calls.
| '''Para llamadas internacionales.'''
| A telephone card?
| '''¿Una tarjeta de teléfono?'''
| Yes ({{=}} '''sí''')! Will you give me a telephone card?
| '''¡Sí! ¿Me da una tarjeta de teléfono?
| For international calls?
| '''¿Para llamadas internacionales?'''
| Yes, for international calls.
| '''Sí, para llamadas internacionales.'''
| Ten euros.
| '''Diez euros.'''
| Thank you.
| '''Gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>
